sketches.mechanism: Ownership transfer (move semantics) — once a value is moved, the original binding can no longer be used, enforced at compile time.
sketches.resonance: Giving yourself to someone means you can no longer access who you were before; the compiler enforces this irreversibility.

sketches.mechanism: Weak references — a weak var automatically becomes nil when the referenced object is deallocated, requiring optional unwrapping.
sketches.resonance: Some bonds refuse to prevent the other from disappearing; you hold on, and one day unwrap nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The `finally` block executes regardless of whether an exception was raised or caught — it runs even after return, break, or unhandled errors.
sketches.resonance: No matter what went wrong, no matter what was caught or missed, some things happen anyway — grief finds you in the finally block.
